FOR AGENTS

Email apart from Chats: My work has an Email link beside Chats, each with its own count of conversations waiting for a reply. Emails open only under Email; web chat, WhatsApp, SMS and social stay under Chats.

Files on replies: attach files with the paperclip, or drag them onto the reply box, several at once. Each shows as a chip you can remove before sending. Each channel keeps its own rules: email within the mailbox's size limit, WhatsApp within Meta's limits, web chat up to 10 MB a file. SMS, Messenger and Instagram carry no files, and the desk says so. If a reply cannot be sent, what you typed stays in the box.

The real channel named: offers, work in hand, My work, chat headers and the Floor name the channel as it is (email, web chat, WhatsApp, SMS, Messenger, Instagram or call). A ticket that came from an email is now email work, whatever its queue's first channel.

Resolving a ticket closes its conversation: when a ticket is resolved or closed, its email or chat is wrapped up and leaves your desk, and your capacity is freed, unless another open ticket still uses it. If the customer writes again, the ticket reopens as before.

Link: tickets a conversation is already on show as linked, and linking that cannot be done says why.

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

Attachment limit per mailbox: under Omnichannel → Email, each mailbox has a size limit for files on replies (20 MB unless changed)."}
